SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUN-03-2008 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUN-03-2008 BY PAUL SLAVIT. ALL PARTIES PRESENT. DEFENDANT CORPORATE SECURITY SERVICE WAIVES SERVICE. EXHIBITS FROM BOTH SIDES RETAINED. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
